Title: 488637-2026: Italy – Works related to refurbishment – Open electronic procedure pursuant to Art. 71 and Art. 44(1) of Legislative Decree No. 36/2023 for the award of the integrated contract for detailed design and execution of works on the basis of the technical-economic feasibility project for the restoration of the L. Meneghetti Student Residence located at Via Sant'Eufemia Nos. 2-4 in Padua.

Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Student residence at a university in Padua — university/campus projects are generally of interest for sbp. However, it is a refurbishment in Italy (not the DACH region) and the scope/complexity of the structural works is unclear, therefore only of medium relevance.
titel: Open electronic procedure for detailed design and construction works for the restoration of the L. Meneghetti Student Residence in Padua
kurzbeschreibung: Restoration of a student residence with detailed design and construction works in Padua.
umfang: Restoration of the L. Meneghetti Student Residence at Via Sant'Eufemia 2-4 in Padua; integrated contract for detailed design and construction works based on a technical-economic feasibility project; optional addition of design and construction of a new escape staircase within the Fabbro building; contract duration 839 days. No specific areas, GFA, number of storeys or spans are stated in the notice.
leistungen: Integrated contract for detailed design and construction works; architectural services for buildings, architectural design as well as construction works related to refurbishment.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• University-related building of a student residence, but without any apparent special structural task or large spans.
• The tender is primarily formulated as construction works with architectural detailed design, not as independent structural design.
• No indications of innovative lightweight, roof, bridge or special structures that would be a particularly good fit for sbp.
• Strategically only of limited interest for sbp, as the focus is on restoration of an existing building.
• The planning component in the integrated procurement model is positive, but overall there is low technical specificity for sbp’s core competencies.
baukosten_erklaerung: Taken from the tender notice; estimated contract value excluding VAT EUR 10,244,147.30 for design and construction in total, not explicitly broken down to cost groups 300/400 only.
honorar_erklaerung: Only the planning share within the integrated contract is explicitly stated: EUR 81,802.46 discountable share plus EUR 151,918.86 fixed price, totalling EUR 233,721.32 for planning services. No specific fee for sbp or for structural design is stated.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Suitability criteria according to the European Single Procurement Document; specific reference requirements or minimum professional qualifications are not stated in the notice itself and are set out in the tender documents.
zuschlagskriterien: Quality 80%; price for construction works 18%; price for planning services 2%.
auftraggeber: UFFICIO GARE, Piazza Antenore 3, 35121 Padova, Italy, E-mail: amministrazione.centrale@pec.unipd.it, Telephone: 0498273225, Website: https://apex.cca.unipd.it/pls/apex/f?p=394:10:10742125249557
notes: Notice in Italian. Electronic submission via https://unipd.ubuy.cineca.it/PortaleAppalti/it/procedure/codice/PG017488. Estimated total value includes options of EUR 1,707,357.88. Site visit optional. RUP is Arch. Stefano Marzaro.
